scope: Fixed current-source mechanism pilot. No production policy, persistence, model performance or rare-failure safety claim.

source_contract.variant: The same qualified FP8-only descriptor port plus fixture-owned validation callback in every cell; no configured-timer guard or old scoped-cache prototype.

activation_values_cpu_proof.limit: CPU mechanism proof, not physical GPU copy/history or native qualification.

source_contract.no_historical_pooling: Earlier source/hardware/protocol batches are context only, not additional trials in this current-source comparison.

qualified_source.version_limit: Official fallback package0.0.0+unknown/unknown; exact source manifests and native artifacts establish identity.

protocol.timing_oracle: Same retained full-layer graphs; GPU events exclude the queued sleep. Queued wall time is diagnostic only.
protocol.first_block_gate: Integrity/comparability only; then all remaining28 workers, independent of observed winners or signs.
protocol.candidate_order_scope: Original ordered candidate pool at each fixed actual profile M must match across cells/processes. Different M endpoints may have different descriptor lists.

analysis.worker_estimator: Median of24 within-round winner/default GPU-event ratios.
analysis.objective_log_contrast: 0.5 * ((log graph_synthetic - log auto_synthetic) + (log graph_captured - log auto_captured))
analysis.values_log_contrast: 0.5 * ((log auto_captured - log auto_synthetic) + (log graph_captured - log graph_synthetic))
analysis.primary_estimator: Exponentiate the arithmetic mean of8 complete-block log contrasts.

bootstrap.sampling: Python random.Random(seed).randrange(8),8 draws per replicate; same resampled block indices for both primary factors and secondary interaction.
bootstrap.quantile: Linear interpolation at sorted index (B-1)*p (Hyndman-Fan type7).
bootstrap.interpretation: Bonferroni-adjusted nominal95% two-factor estimation family; exploratory percentile intervals with only8 blocks, no formal equivalence or superiority conclusion.

secondary: All four cell worker distributions and full block contrasts; interaction; profiler margins by bucket; selection/kernel/native identities; order strata; paired queued wall diagnostics.

material_regression.scope: Research classifier, not a production replacement margin or safety policy.

frequency_uncertainty.limit: Fixed-input process repetitions may be nonstationary/dependent; binomial bounds are conditional and not safety certification.

analysis.no_pooling: No historical pooling or within-worker pseudo-replication; all outcomes, failed selections and traces retained.
analysis.small_effect_limit: Calibration showed recipe sensitivity around1.3–1.5% and unresolved sub-percent capture effects. Same-default small ratios do not demonstrate a speedup.

values_limits: Matched allocation/copy operations do not prove identical physical copy history: captured and synthetic source addresses/contents differ. Main F0 startup has no direct synthetic-byte fingerprint; log target/layout/control metadata, RNG states and source pins without claiming byte attestation.

The synthetic arm includes matched clone/copy work and is not an untouched production-initializer baseline. The factor compares two controlled initializer recipes. Distinct source addresses/contents can cause physical history differences, so any factor effect cannot be attributed solely to activation-value distribution.
admission: Before the cohort, qualify all four objective-by-values cells using actual GPU initializer semantics in disposable correctness-only controls with explicit hashes: nine shapes/keys/order/RNG unchanged, only M144 A differs, weights/scales unchanged. Check matching objective/policy identity and exact public capture operands. Do not count these instrumented admissions as performance trials or silently insert hashes into cohort startup.

stopping.integrity_failure: Stop and preserve all outcomes; no retry or silent substitution.

limits: Research source with unmerged FP8 runtime/callback patches, not stock FlashInfer.

Selected explicit native acceptance after timing proves viability on the retained problem, not observation of native return during the earlier capture. Capture lookup/submitted-tactic provenance and same-original-graph trace are separate required evidence.
No scoped-cache prototype, persistence claim, production policy change, distributed adoption or full-model performance inference.
All-default or neutral results show only no demonstrated benefit in this one fixed current-source case.
